create_gym_atari_env: create a GymAtari dm_env wrapper for an Atari game with sticky actions and a seed
register_atari_environments: register all 57 Atari environments in Gym with optional sticky action variants
wrap_env_with_random_noops: wrap a dm_env environment with RandomNoopsEnvironmentWrapper to apply random noop actions at episode start
get_observation_and_action_specs: get the observation spec tuple and discrete action spec from a GymAtari environment instance
step_atari_environment: step a GymAtari environment with an action and receive a dm_env timestep with observation, reward, and lives
